gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologic confirmed glioblastoma (WHO grade IV), IDH wild type per IHC

candidate_evidence.quote: [DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] Lumber Puncture (other names: LP): During the lumbar puncture/LP, 20cc will be collected per standard practice in adult patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Cohort A will consist of newly diagnosed patients with Glioblastoma.
No prior tumor-directed therapies except surgical resection or biopsy

source_quote.quote: Cohort B will consist of patients with a histologically confirmed diagnosis of IDH WT glioblastoma.
The goal of this study is to determine the utility of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) cell-free DNA (cfDNA) as a prognostic biomarker in glioblastoma (GBM).

coder_notes: Phase NA diagnostic study; only intervention is a lumbar puncture (diagnostic test), no drug. Cohort A enrols presumed high-grade glioma before pathology; Cohort B requires IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. IDH-wildtype coded enrichment for Cohort B only (defines GBM; never candidate-matched).
